title: Sanger Tree of Life HMW DNA Extraction: Manual Tissue Nanobind
author: Pacific Biosciences

steps.title: Initial Tissue Processing
steps.instruction: Prepare the tissue sample based on its state and add buffer CT.

substeps.instruction: Transfer cryoprepped tissue to a 2 mL microcentrifuge tube, or whole tissue to a 1.5 mL BioMasher II tube.
Add 750 μL ice cold buffer CT.
If cryoprepped: pipette mix 5-10 times with a wide-bore pipette tip to homogenise.

If whole tissue: Powermash using the Diagnocine PowerMasher II tissue disruptor and BioMasher pestle until no large pieces remain or sample cannot be disrupted further, then transfer lysate to a 2 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: First Wash and Homogenization
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the sample and rehomogenize with buffer CT.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 6,000 g at 4 °C for 5 minutes.
Discard supernatant and add 1 mL ice cold buffer CT.
Pipette mix 10 times with a wide-bore pipette tip to dislodge pellet and rehomogenise sample.

steps.title: Pellet Collection
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the homogenate to pellet the sample.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 6,000 g at 4 °C for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Protein Digestion
steps.instruction: Add Proteinase K and buffer CLE3, then incubate.

substeps.instruction: Add 20 μL of proteinase K to the pellet and pulse vortex for 1 second 2 times at the maximum setting to dislodge the pellet.
Add 150 μL of buffer CLE3 and pipette mix 10 times using a wide-bore pipette tip.
Incubate sample at 55 °C and 900 rpm for 30 minutes on the heat block.
Spin on a mini-centrifuge for 2 seconds to collect liquid from the lid.

steps.title: RNA Digestion
steps.instruction: Add RNase A and incubate to remove RNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 20 μL of RNase A.
Incubate at 55 °C and 900 rpm on the heat block for another 30 minutes (up to 2 hours if large tissue pieces remain).

steps.title: Lysate Preparation
steps.instruction: Add buffer SB and centrifuge to separate the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Add 60 μL buffer SB and pulse vortex for 1 second 5 times at the maximum setting (or pipette mix 5 times with wide-bore tip).
Centrifuge at 10,000 g at room temperature (15-30 °C) for 5 minutes.
Transfer up to 300 μL of the supernatant to a new labelled 1.5 mL Protein LoBind microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: DNA Binding Preparation
steps.instruction: Add buffer BL3 and prepare for Nanobind disk binding.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 μL of buffer BL3 to the collected supernatant and mix by inverting 10 times (or pipette mix 10 times with wide-bore tip).
Spin on a mini-centrifuge for 2 seconds to collect liquid from the lid.
Add a Nanobind disk to the lysate.
Add 350 μL isopropanol and mix by inverting 10 times.

steps.title: DNA Binding
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample to allow DNA to bind to the disk.

substeps.instruction: Mix sample for 15 minutes at room temperature using one of the following: platform rocker at 20 rpm, HulaMixer at 25 rpm (reciprocal angle 50°), or manual inversion every 3 minutes.

steps.title: Supernatant Removal
steps.instruction: Use a magnetic rack to isolate the disk and remove the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Place the tubes on the magnetic rack.
Discard the supernatant using a pipette (avoiding the disk) or by tipping into a reservoir.

steps.title: Disk Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the Nanobind disk with buffers CW1 and CW2.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 μL of Buffer CW1, remove from magnet, mix by inverting 4 times, return to rack, and discard supernatant. Repeat this process once more.
Add 500 μL of Buffer CW2, remove from magnet, mix by inverting 4 times, return to rack, and discard supernatant. Repeat this process once more.

steps.title: Drying and Final Preparation
steps.instruction: Remove residual liquid and air-dry the disk.

substeps.instruction: Spin samples on a mini-centrifuge for 2 seconds to collect liquid from the lid.
Place samples back on the magnetic rack and remove any residual supernatant.
Incubate sample for 10 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: DNA Elution
steps.instruction: Elute the HMW DNA from the Nanobind disk.

substeps.instruction: Remove tubes from the magnetic rack and add 100 μL Buffer LTE directly onto the nanobind disk.
Spin the tube on a mini-centrifuge for 5 seconds.
Use a standard P200 pipette to combine any additional liquid or gel coming off the disk to the previous eluate; repeat until all liquid/gel is removed.
Collect the resulting supernatant containing HMW DNA and transfer to a new labelled 1.5 mL Protein LoBind microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Post-Elution Processing and Storage
steps.instruction: Homogenize the eluate and allow DNA to relax before storage or QC.

substeps.instruction: Pipette mix the sample 5 times with a standard P200 pipette tip to homogenise and disrupt viscous gel regions.
Allow the sample to rest overnight at room temperature for the DNA to relax and solubilise.
Following the overnight rest, pipette mix the sample 5 times with a standard P200 pipette tip before proceeding with QC.
Store the DNA at 4 ºC.
